subject: planner: fix the issue that Update on partition tables can't hit the Instance Plan Cache (#57787)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: Update plan-cache cloning now shallow-copies `Update.PartitionedTable` (previously cloning rejected non-nil), enabling instance plan cache hits for UPDATE on partitioned tables (including specified partitions). The field is only read during executor build to swap in partition-selection-aware table wrappers; the underlying wrapper state is read-only, so no correctness/semantics/concurrency/txn issues at Blocker/High level were found.
